<function name="SetDividerHeight" parent="DVerticalDivider" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets the height of the divider bar between the top and bottom content panels of the <page>DVerticalDivider</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="height" type="number">The height of the divider bar.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
